Our Mission

A technology-first company, Arbe’s elite team of semiconductor engineers, radar specialists and data scientists are ushering in a zero-road-fatality reality by enabling truly safe driver-assist systems that are paving the way for a fully autonomous driving future.

Our Culture

Being part of the Arbe team is more than just coming to work each day. It’s about building something with global impact. We are proud of the tech we’re developing in pursuit of our larger mission: making zero road fatalities a reality for everyone.

A technology-first company, Arbe’s elite team of semiconductor engineers, radar specialists and data scientists are ushering in a zero-road-fatality reality by enabling truly safe driver-assist systems that are paving the way for a fully autonomous driving future.

  • Our mission
  • Our culture
  • Open position

Being part of the Arbe team is more than just coming to work each day. It’s about building something with global impact. We are proud of the tech we’re developing in pursuit of our larger mission: making zero road fatalities a reality for everyone. 

To achieve this, every day we brainstorm, debate, create, collaborate, argue, laugh, push, and iterate together from our office in central Tel Aviv. As a startup, our work is versatile, fast-paced, and collaborative. No matter our title or role, we never sit still. In short, we work hard, and have a blast doing it.
